newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso pares losses vs dollar ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso pares losses vs dollar ahead of FOMC.

text.p: The Mexican peso recouped some of its earlier losses against the dollar towards the close on Tuesday in a market eagerly awaiting news from the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee, traders said.
"It seems there will be no news until tomorrow, and as our markets are closed on Wednesday, people preferred to sit on the sidelines and wait," a dealer said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate closed 0.2 and 0.6 of a centavo weaker, respectively, at 7.8220/7.8270 and 7.8200/7.8240 per dollar.
The FOMC meeting was scheduled to begin shortly before the Mexican foreign exchange market closed.
Mexican financial markets will be closed on Wednesday for Constitution Day.
"Dealers were also very quiet because of the forthcoming holiday," a trader said.
Same-day peso contracts earlier closed 1.3 centavos weaker at 7.8215/7.8250 per dollar.
